name: How To Build Any App From Idea To Shelf
tagline: An AI product manager that plans an app from concept through launch handoff
description: It works as the product manager on your idea, producing the blueprint, the money model, the loops that keep users around, the referral mechanics, and the handoff docs a team needs. Rewards schemes wait on purpose until the product can actually carry them.
author: TripVoxel
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
